# minio_iam_group (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "minio_iam_group" "developer" {
  name = "developer"
}

output "minio_user_group" {
  value = minio_iam_group.developer.group_name
}
```

~> Changing `name` replaces the group: MinIO has no rename operation, so Terraform destroys the old group and creates a new one. Group memberships and policy attachments are separate resources and must be re-applied against the new group.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group. MinIO has no rename operation, so changing this forces a new group to be created.

### Optional

- `disable_group` (Boolean) Disable group
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete group even if it has non-Terraform-managed members

### Read-Only

- `group_name` (String) The name of the group.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# IAM groups can be imported using the group name
terraform import minio_iam_group.example group-name
```
